name: facebookresearch_robustcvd/raft/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_robustcvd/raft/evaluate.run_validate_chairs: run the RAFT model validation on the FlyingChairs dataset and print EPE metrics
facebookresearch_robustcvd/raft/evaluate.run_validate_sintel: run the RAFT model validation on the MpiSintel training split for clean and final types
facebookresearch_robustcvd/raft/evaluate.run_validate_kitti: run the RAFT model validation on the KITTI-2015 training split and print EPE and F1 scores
facebookresearch_robustcvd/raft/evaluate.create_sintel_submission: create optical flow submission files for the Sintel leaderboard test split in .flo format
facebookresearch_robustcvd/raft/evaluate.create_kitti_submission: create optical flow submission files for the KITTI test split in the KITTI format

facebookresearch_robustcvd/raft/main.py.run_stereo_flow_estimation: run optical flow estimation on stereo image pairs using the RAFT model with a given checkpoint
facebookresearch_robustcvd/raft/main.py.load_image_list: load a list of right image files and their corresponding left pairs as padded tensors on CUDA
facebookresearch_robustcvd/raft/main.py.viz_flow_map: visualize horizontal optical flow as an RGB image and save it to a PNG file
facebookresearch_robustcvd/raft/main.py.load_image: load a single image file from disk and convert it to a PyTorch tensor with channel-first format
facebookresearch_robustcvd/raft/main.py.extract_disparity: extract horizontal flow values as disparity maps and save them as NumPy arrays

facebookresearch_robustcvd/raft/train.py.train_RAFT_model: train a RAFT optical flow model on a specified dataset with configurable learning rate and iterations
facebookresearch_robustcvd/raft/train.py.compute_sequence_loss: compute the sequence loss over flow predictions with weighted temporal averaging and EPE metrics
facebookresearch_robustcvd/raft/train.py.create_optimizer_and_scheduler: create an AdamW optimizer and OneCycleLR scheduler for a RAFT model with configurable learning rate
facebookresearch_robustcvd/raft/train.py.log_training_metrics: log training metrics and loss values to TensorBoard at regular intervals during model training
facebookresearch_robustcvd/raft/train.py.count_model_parameters: count the number of trainable parameters in a PyTorch model for reporting and debugging
